# Sample Wrong Answers Collection

> Wrong Answer Collection — synthetic fixture mirroring the collection format
> (numbered items, → **Answer:**, Key words/Trap blockquotes, ✅ options).

## Fill-in-the-Blank

### Amphibians

1. The frog **(croak)** loudly every night near the pond.
   → **Answer:** croaks
   > **Key words:** "every night" — habitual action requires present simple
   > **Trap:** Students use the bare form "croak" or past tense.

2. By the time we arrived, the tadpoles **(transform)** into frogs.
   → **Answer:** had transformed
   > **Key words:** "by the time we arrived" — past reference point before another past event

### Grammar: Verb Tenses

1. She **(study)** for three hours when the power went out.
   → **Answer:** had been studying
   > **Key words:** "for three hours" + "when the power went out"

2. The twins **(argue)** about the toy when mum walked in.
   → **Answer:** were arguing
   > **Trap:** Students pick simple past "argued" instead of past continuous.

## Multiple Choice

43. The alarm **\_** for ten minutes before anyone woke up.
    A. rang &emsp; B. has rung &emsp; C. has been ringing &emsp; **✅ D. had been ringing**
    > **Key words:** "for ten minutes" + "before anyone woke up"

44. The chef **\_** the soup before serving it to the guests.
    **✅ A. tasted** &emsp; B. tastes &emsp; C. is tasting &emsp; D. has tasted
    > **Key words:** "before serving" — completed action first

## Grammar Guide

### 1. Passive Voice

1. Original object → new subject
2. Original verb → be + past participle
3. Original subject → by + subject
